backendInput.capture: ordered CMUdict membership lookups plus one wrapped mecab.MeCab.pos invocation per case

coverage: source-ordered overlapping idioms, numeric exceptions, and units
POS-sensitive complex-batchim, palatalization, and ui rules
native-counter boundaries, Unicode decimals, numeral place limit, and seeded set-order overlap
ARPABET fricative, affricate, nasal, liquid, glide, case, and overlap paths
non-overlapping silent-onset insertion across adjacent ARPABET vowels

expectedFailures.cause: Pinned process_num leaves name unbound for a nonzero digit at position 16

coverage: overlapping bare numerals and repeated prefixes
spaced, unspaced, repeated, and overlapping bound nouns
